entities.name: Abd Allah ibn Abd al-Latif Al al-alSheikh
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAbd al-Laṭīf Āl ash-Shaykh was a scholar from Nejd in Arabia and was the grandfather of King Faisal. He was a descendant of Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al Wahhāb.
